decisions.reason: The ID Vault was only launched in August 2023 and adds a natural feature to the super-app identity offering, so management lacks enough evidence of a shortfall against aspirations to start problemistic search.

The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the payment framework, which makes it a candidate for consolidation, but it still fits the super-app ecosystem and is too new to judge.

The NFC tag authenticator is a niche hardware-linked product with uncertain demand and only a passing website mention, but its low maintenance cost and fit with the authentication portfolio let the firm carry it for now.
The payment and wallet framework has its own page and is a core building block of the platform strategy for financial customers, so management signals commitment to it.
As the flagship super-app platform that defines the firm's strategic direction, it will be kept regardless of early results.
Application shielding builds on decades of core app-security expertise, has its own page, and likely draws on established enterprise demand, so it is unlikely to fall below aspirations.
